Yd.bar_b_note: B's panel is clean and legible, but the dark rainy world behind it is murky and flat, and the Craft/Leave prompts are small white text with tiny glyphs rather than the bold, colour-keyed controller prompts a shipping game uses.

He.bar_b_note: A low-resolution, soft-textured grunt whose eyes read as dark smudges and whose all-black outfit gives no silhouette or appeal at small size sinks it.

Yz.bar_b_note: An appealing, well-lit stylised villager with a palette that fits Meadows carries it, but the fuzzy, felt-like hair and beard and plain studio stage keep it short of shipping finish.

Xb.bar_b_note: The face, eyes and outfit read clearly and fit the world, but the hair and beard are still a soft, blurry mass with only the outline broken into locks, below the finish of the owner's bar.

Pz.bar_b_note: Smeared ground textures, a flat sky with no atmosphere or light shafts, uniform low-poly tree walls and sparse props sink it next to Palworld's dense, saturated fields.

Zg.bar_b_note: A's bold banding reads well, but its faint poses float upright in mid-air and its material washes to pale yellow; B is grounded, but its noisy mottled surface muddies the silhouette, so neither reaches the owner's creature bar.

top_changes.change: Lift the Meadows world in the Pz sites to the key art: replace the smeared ground textures with crisp grass/dirt materials and grass clumps, break the uniform tree walls into groves and edges, and add a warm sun grade with cool blue distance fog and a painted sky

Rebuild the character hair and beard as layered locks/hair cards with alpha-tested strand edges (Yz/Xb villager), and replace the low-res Team Tether grunt (He) with a higher-detail model with real eye whites and pupils and a broken-up silhouette

Keep serpent hit and faint poses on the ground with a stable material (Zg A), drop the visible oxblood enemy banners from post-win frames (Pz B), and give craft-panel actions bold teal controller-glyph prompts
